scope: Independent read-only review of the oracle witness only; no ref update, workflow dispatch, retry, cancellation, or scale claim.

reasoning: Witness admission requires ordinary stored tables, identical projected column layouts, complete B validation/accounting, exact row counts and both EOFs.
Pointwise raw SQLite type/value equality is stricter than canonical Value equality: integer/real, blob/text, different real bit patterns and different layouts fall back.
Signed zero bit differences fall back, retaining original serialized ordering, Value equality and distinct digests.
Successful witness still iterates the sorted A canonical stream, compares each row with the proven-identical B alias before feeding both hashers.
Failed witness discards speculative byte accounting and invokes the unchanged full B spool.

strict_contract_blockers.detail: A successful witness never writes side B into canonical_rows. An input where side A fits max_scratch_bytes but A+B would hit SQLITE_FULL can now succeed. The candidate review explicitly acknowledges that B-only SQLITE_FULL/I/O failure order is not preserved; current 64KiB test only proves a case where side A itself fails.
Each public table result adds equal_input_order_witness. Prior report fields remain, but byte/schema protocol is not unchanged.

The fixed v2 Python/SQLite diagnostic median ratio is 0.9076299483 only for same-order equality, but 1.3683205413 for reverse-order equality and 1.2254548335 for last-row mismatch. The real scale driver mutates A incrementally and fully rebuilds B before most parity stages, so rowid/insertion order identity is not established and fallback can add a second B projection pass.

required_narrow_resolution: Do not adopt this witness as the requested strict-equivalence optimization while exact scratch-failure behavior and unchanged report protocol are requirements.

If engineering accepts relaxed physical-failure equivalence, remove the public equal_input_order_witness field or version the protocol explicitly, and use actual representative scale stages to measure per-table witness success/fallback before any speed claim.

For a strict candidate, prefer eliminating the duplicate per-column ValueRef read by fusing raw-size accounting with projection while preserving first-pass error precedence; keep the original two-side spool, sorted streams, Value equality, every-row-before-hash, and all limits.
verdict: reject_for_round38_strict_contract; source witness appears logically conservative for equality but is not protocol/capacity-failure equivalent and has no demonstrated G3-domain speedup
